referencePolicy.sourcePriority: Current official PhiladelphiaEagles.com player roster/headshot page
referencePolicy.visualRule: Artists/generators must inspect the cited current official headshot before rendering. Do not infer skin tone, hair, facial hair, or facial features from a name, biography, position, or stale asset.
referencePolicy.style: realistic 3D chibi; adult football proportions; recognizable at Gamecast scale

render.camera: three-quarter front; match approved Dallas production camera
render.lighting: soft stadium key plus cool rim; match approved Dallas production lighting
render.numberAccuracy: required; re-check official roster before final render

verification.rosterCrossCheck: All ten players are present on the current official Philadelphia active roster snapshot used by PHI/roster.json; jersey numbers are locked to that snapshot and must be rechecked at render time.
verification.appearanceSafety: Reference lock means the official current headshot page is established as the source of truth. It does not authorize guessing traits that are not visibly confirmed from that headshot.
verification.signatureSafety: No named Philadelphia player-specific celebration is asserted by this batch. Signature research remains a later phase and requires a verifiable source.
